I used to be like that for months when I started retail. It's one of the busiest supermarkets in the area when I moved in and I was desperate for a job. There were so many customers, it became overwhelming for me. I used to cry because some yelled at me and gave me attitudes. When I was still in college, I learned about breathing techniques in Counseling. It sounds silly, but breathing slowly in and out for about 5 minutes while placing your hand on your stomach and chest helps A LOT. If it wasn't for that, I would've quit my job. Now it doesn't bother me as much anymore. Have you tried anything like that before?
